name: Havenfall Is for Lovers
source:
Vampires, Werewolves, and Demons, oh my! Life in a small town seems so simple until your sister goes missing, and the only ones willing to help you are supernatural beings! Trusting a monster takes bravery and courage, and maybe just a little bit of…love?

[From [url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/165121978643/pilot-series-havenfall-is-for-lovers-out-now]Voltage Lovestruck blog[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼、狼人和恶魔，天哪！小镇的生活看似简单，直到你的妹妹失踪，而唯一愿意帮助你的人就是超自然生物！信任一个怪物需要勇气和勇气，也许还需要一点点……爱？

[来自[url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/165121978643/pilot-series-havenfall-is-for-lovers-out-now]Voltage Lovestruck博客[/url]]
